fusions.name: Locked Gaze
fusions.desc: Fixes on the target and bites for 13 damage, leaving it [Stunned] for 1.2 seconds, and [Marked] and 10% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Nothing Unseen
fusions.desc: Bites every enemy within 3.5 tiles and deals 26 damage that is always a critical hit. It deals 8% more for each affliction already on the target, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Set to Watch
fusions.desc: Sets a watchdog on your enemies for 15 seconds. It bites an enemy within 5 tiles every 1.5 seconds and deals 5 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Sighthound
fusions.desc: You have 10% more dodge chance against enemies carrying one of your afflictions.
